creativeDirection: Adult wonder, dream logic, playful discovery and specific gentle impossibility; warm, curious and inviting.
design: Adult Vex with rich purple hair in a thick loose side braid, violet eyes, purple wolf ears with pale inner fur and a full purple tail. Dusty-teal long tailcoat, plum waistcoat and flowing skirt, ivory high-neck ruffled blouse, dark tights, teal ankle boots and rose-gold crescent pin. Open conversational stance, one palm raised beneath a single hovering ivory origami butterfly and the other hand at the coat near her waist.

neutral.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE revised full-body Whimsical Vex visual-novel sprite sample, for the creator to review before any expression-set generation.
Edit target: the supplied existing Whimsical Vex. Preserve the same adult woman in her late twenties, mature face and proportions, pale skin, violet eyes, rich purple hair in its thick loose side braid with soft face-framing waves, purple wolf ears with pale inner fur, and one full fluffy purple tail. Preserve her dusty-teal long tailcoat, plum waistcoat and flowing below-knee skirt, ivory high-neck ruffled blouse, opaque dark tights, teal leather ankle boots, rose-gold crescent moon pin, fabric textures and polished detailed anime painting style.

Primary change: make her personality visible through a curious, open pose and adult wonder. Whimsical Vex finds enchanting possibilities in ordinary things: dream logic, playful discovery and specific gentle impossibility. She is imaginative, warm and inviting, with a little theatrical delight.

Replace the formal wrist-holding pose with an open conversational stance. Keep her balanced standing in a three-quarter view, shoulders relaxed and open, body turned subtly toward the viewer, head with a small inquisitive tilt. One forearm extends comfortably at waist-to-chest height, open palm facing up, natural softly curved fingers. Her other hand rests lightly against the edge of her coat near her waist, natural fingers. Both hands clearly readable.
Add ONE small ivory folded-paper butterfly hovering an inch above her open palm. Its crisp folded geometry and slight rose-gold touches make it recognizable as paper. It should feel like a familiar little impossible thing she has just shown you. It stays close to her palm and within the figure's silhouette, with no trails, particles, swirling effects or glow.
Her face has attentive violet eyes more open and engaged than the reference, gently lifted eyebrows, and a warm, intrigued asymmetric smile with lightly parted lips. She looks delighted that the world still has a surprise for her, as though inviting you to notice it too. Keep mature facial features and a versatile base expression that can later support the full emotional range. Ears perked with attentive curiosity, tail naturally curved.

Portrait 1024 x 1536. ONE complete full-body character, entire ear tips, hair, hands, butterfly, coat, skirt, tail and both boot soles within frame with comfortable clear margins. Level camera, natural anatomy, soft even character illumination.
Preserve real transparent alpha. No background, scenery, floor, cast shadow, haze, halo, vignette, lettering, logos, labels, extra characters, expression sheet, or alternate views. No childish proportions, exaggerated huge eyes, magician hat, paint-spattered artist clothes, weapons, or additional decorative clutter.
